info.name: Yapily Beneficiaries Application Beneficiaries Data Plus API

items.docs: Trigger categorisation for transactions from [AIS (see Get Transactions endpoint)](/api-reference/getTransactions) in the specified time range.

params.name: categorisationId
params.description: Unique identifier for transaction categorisation request

params.name: limit
params.description: __Optional__. The maximum number of transaction records to be returned. Must be between 100 and 1000. If not specified will default to 100.

params.name: page
params.description: __Optional__. The page number to be returned. If not specified will default to 1.
